title: SAP Supply Chain Analytics Lead - SCM
description:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work-work that changes the world-is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

THE ROLE

As the SAP Supply Chain Analytics Lead, you will serve as the technical driver behind Everpure’s digital transformation ecosystem, turning complex global operational data into decisive business action. Operating at an Individual Contributor level, you will architect scalable data models and analytics applications that bridge the gap between core SAP S/4HANA transactional systems and modern cloud intelligence platforms. In close collaboration with leaders across eight supply chain sub-departments, your mission is to eliminate operational blind spots, accelerate decision-making, and optimize global planning, procurement, and logistics capabilities.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

•
Architect Enterprise Supply Chain Data Models: Determine the optimal methods and procedures to conceptualize, build, and maintain multi-dimensional data models across SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) and SAP Datasphere, unifying complex demand planning, inventory, warehousing, and transportation workflows into scalable analytics assets.

•
Modernize Cloud Analytics Infrastructure: Lead the transition of legacy data pipelines to modern cloud architectures (such as SAP Datasphere, Databricks, or Snowflake), establishing seamless data flows between SAP S/4HANA, Ariba, and IBP to ensure peak platform reliability and performance.

•
Deliver Strategic BI Products & Dashboards: Design and deploy end-to-end analytical applications, executive scorecards, and operational KPIs that give business leaders real-time visibility into supplier challenges, forecasting accuracy, and fulfillment bottlenecks.

•
Coordinate Cross-Functional Alignment: Translate complex business requests from diverse functional stakeholders into unified technical roadmaps, aligning engineering squads and supply chain sub-departments around standardized metrics and governance practices.

•
Resolve High-Impact System Challenges: Perform root-cause analysis on complex integration barriers spanning core SAP modules (MM, PP, SD), applying innovative problem-solving to improve data accessibility, reporting velocity, and operational scalability.

• We are primarily an in-office environment and therefore, you will be expected to work from the Santa Clara, CA office in compliance with Everpure's policies, unless you are on PTO, or work travel, or other approved leave.

WHAT YOU BRING

•
Advanced SAP Analytics Expertise: Deep technical mastery in configuring and deploying end-to-end data products using SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC), SAP Datasphere, SAP Business Warehouse (BW/4HANA), or SAP Business Data Cloud.

•
End-to-End Supply Chain Domain Knowledge: Broad functional understanding of core supply chain processes-including demand and supply planning, Materials Management (MM), Production Planning (PP), Sales & Distribution (SD), and Configure-to-Order (CTO) scenarios-to effectively model enterprise data.

•
Systems Integration & Modern Architecture Savvy: Proven success connecting core ERP systems (SAP S/4HANA, SAP IBP) with advanced cloud data warehouses (Snowflake, Databricks) using SAP Activate and Agile frameworks.

•
Consultative Stakeholder Engagement: Exceptional communication and relationship-building skills, with a track record of translating intricate data architecture concepts into compelling strategic recommendations for non-technical executives.

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life - or even a third.

title: Staff Security Engineer
description:
ABOUT LIVEKIT

LiveKit is building the infrastructure layer for the agentic era of computing. Our platform gives developers everything they need to build, test, deploy, scale, and observe AI agents in production. Founded in 2021, LiveKit powers voice and agentic AI applications for OpenAI, Salesforce, Spotify, Meta, and tens of thousands of other developers, collectively facilitating billions of calls each year.

ABOUT THIS ROLE

This isn't one of those roles where "security" means running scans or writing policies that gather dust. We're looking for a real engineer - someone who thinks like a builder and a breaker. Someone who gets deep into the stack, whether it's an API endpoint, a container image, or a browser sandbox. You know how things are supposed to work - and what happens when they don't.

While some security professionals lean toward policy, compliance, or audits (and we value that too), we're after someone who wants to write code, secure systems, dig into strange bugs, and harden the platform from top to bottom. This is not a role for pointing out what needs to be done. It's for someone who's ready to do it.

YOU'LL THRIVE HERE IF YOU:

- think like both a builder and a breaker, and understand security from first principles

- can analyze systems for weaknesses - whether they're in business logic, configuration, or code

- translate security concerns into engineering action without being the "no" person

- are an excellent communicator who can document and evangelize best practices across the org

- stay current with security research, tooling, and threats - and put that knowledge into action

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Own security across the stack - applications, services, infrastructure, and developer workflows

- Proactively identify, assess, and mitigate risks in both infrastructure and application codebases

- Lead secure code reviews, architecture discussions, and threat modeling sessions

- Build tooling and automations that help prevent security issues before they reach production

- Harden authentication and access control across internal and external surfaces

- Partner closely with engineers across teams to design secure-by-default APIs, workflows, and deployments

- Investigate vulnerabilities, respond to security incidents, and manage disclosure processes when needed

WHO YOU ARE

- 6+ years of experience as a software engineer with a strong interest in security engineering

- You've led or heavily contributed to security engineering efforts across applications, infrastructure, or both

- Experienced with threat modeling, secure coding practices, and vulnerability management

- Worked with CI/CD systems, cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, etc.), and containerized environments

- You've responded to real-world security incidents, led postmortems, or driven remediation efforts

NICE TO HAVE

- Experience with security reviews of WebRTC, media pipelines, or real-time systems

- Contributions to open-source security tooling or research

- Hands-on experience with static and dynamic analysis tools, fuzzing, or sandboxing

- You've built (or tried to build) something with LiveKit

OUR COMMITMENT TO YOU

- An opportunity to build something truly impactful to the world

- Contribute to open source alongside world-class engineers

- Competitive salary and equity package

- Health, dental, and vision benefits

- Flexible vacation policy

LiveKit is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any characteristic protected by applicable law. If you require a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact recruiting@livekit.io.

title: Research Assistant, Test Assembly & Desktop Publishing
description:

This role also provides assistance in formatting test materials, ensuring alignment with CAL’s style guide, WCAG requirements, and print specifications. This role is responsible for accurately transferring test content into InDesign templates, performing quality control reviews, and supporting the production of error-free, accessible test forms and ancillary materials.
ESSENTIAL DUTIES:
Test Form Assembly and Layout

• Transfer and lay out test content (text and graphics) in Adobe InDesign, following established templates, the CAL style guide, WCAG requirements, and print specifications.

• Assist in the creation and maintenance of test booklets, administration scripts, and other ancillary test materials in both print and computer-based formats.

• Assist in preparing and reviewing test blueprints and item inventories to support test form construction.

• Collaborate with the Desktop Publishing Graphic Designer to implement layout adjustments and minor graphic edits in Adobe InDesign.

Quality Control and Review

• Perform systematic quality control reviews of print-based and computer-based test materials to verify accuracy, consistency, and alignment with test specifications, content standards, WCAG requirements, and formatting requirements.

• Review assessment materials using screen reader software to verify the accuracy of alternate text and document accessibility.

• Support the Test Assembly Manager in maintaining, documenting, and improving quality control procedures and checklists.

• Track stakeholder feedback, implement approved revisions, and maintain complete, auditable revision histories.

• Support mock test administrations and revise materials based on findings and user feedback.

Documentation, Data, and Process Support

• Maintain test item databases and item banks, ensuring records remain accurate, current, and complete.

• Assist with the maintenance of the internal style guide and the documentation of test assembly procedures.

• Maintain strict confidentiality and adhere to test security protocols in the handling of secure assessment content.

• Perform other responsibilities as assigned.

title: Product Owner
description:
About The Lisinski Law Firm
Since 2020, Lisinski Law Firm has served as a dedicated humanitarian immigration practice committed to providing meaningful support to individuals and families seeking safety, stability, and a path forward. We frequently stand with clients who have been turned away elsewhere, offering both advocacy and care. Joining our Firm means becoming part of a team devoted to keeping families together and “Changing as Many Lives as Possible.”
About the Role
The Product Owner is the day-to-day owner of a defined product or feature set within a broader product area at LLF. They are responsible for the health of their product’s backlog; refining work, authoring clear user stories with acceptance criteria, prioritizing tactically within the sprint cadence, and serving as the primary product voice to IT during execution.
This role focuses on execution, ownership, and operational consistency in a regulated, high-stakes legal services environment. Working in close partnership with Product Managers, IT, the Project Management Office (PMO), and operational stakeholders, the Product Owner ensures that strategic product intent translates into well-formed, well-prioritized work that engineering can deliver predictably. The Product Owner also organizes and drives the "Quick Wins" pipeline for their product area; surfacing, scoping, and shepherding smaller improvements that deliver tangible value alongside larger initiatives.
This role operates as an individual contributor, partnering closely with Product Managers and reporting to a Product Team Lead.
Your Key Contributions

• Own the day-to-day health of the product backlog for an assigned product or feature set - including authoring and refining user stories, acceptance criteria, and supporting documentation.

• Partner with Product Managers to take ownership of epics and break them down into well-formed user stories that can be slotted into the team’s sprint cadence.

• Organize and drive the Quick Wins pipeline for the assigned product area - surfacing smaller improvements, scoping them appropriately, and shepherding them through delivery.

• Participate actively in sprint ceremonies (planning, refinement, review, retrospective) as the primary product voice to IT.

• Tactically prioritize work within the sprint and near-term backlog, making routine trade-off decisions and escalating non-routine ones to the Product Manager or Product Team Lead.

• Resolve routine execution exceptions - answering engineering questions, refining acceptance criteria, and unblocking story-level ambiguity during the sprint.

• Validate that delivered work meets acceptance criteria and product intent before sign-off.

• Maintain operational consistency in how product work is captured, refined, prioritized, and tracked, contributing to team standards and reducing rework.

• Partner with PMO on sprint-level reporting, dependency tracking, and risk surfacing.

• Engage with operational and end-user stakeholders to gather feedback, clarify needs, and validate that delivered work solves the intended problem.

• Ensure work is delivered in a manner consistent with the firm’s regulatory, ethical, and data-handling obligations, escalating to the Product Manager or Legal/Compliance when in doubt.

• Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Science, Information Systems, a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

• Demonstrated experience authoring user stories and acceptance criteria for software products.

• Demonstrated experience working within an Agile/Scrum environment, including active participation in sprint ceremonies.

• Working knowledge of Agile/Scrum frameworks and sprint-based software delivery.

• Proficiency with product/backlog management tooling (e.g., Craft.io, Jira, Azure DevOps, or equival

title: Head of Telematics Data Science
description:
ABOUT ZEGO 🚀

At Zego, we're on a mission to do the good thing, not the insurance thing.

Insurance hasn't changed much in over a century. The way we live, work and travel has. We're building the real-time, AI-driven infrastructure that powers innovative insurance, so good drivers get cover that works the way they actually drive.

We're not just updating insurance. We're leading the AI evolution in insurance 🤖. For us, AI isn't a line on a roadmap or a buzzword on a slide. It's our operating reality, and it's how we build products that back drivers instead of the old insurance playbook.

We don't do things slowly, and we don't do bureaucracy. We back high-performance builders who want ownership, early responsibility and the chance to do the most career-defining work of their lives. You'll get the space to try things, the tools to move fast, and the room to see your ideas reach millions of drivers.

Do not take our word for it. Read what Zegons say about us on Glassdoor https://www.glassdoor.co.uk/Overview/Working-at-Zego-Insurance-EI_IE1851459.11,25.htm.

If you're ready to build the future of insurance, we're hiring.

PURPOSE OF THE ROLE

Zego has recorded over a billion miles of real-world driving, captured from phone sensors (accelerometer, GPS and more) across tens of thousands of policies and four very different kinds of driving: private car, van, taxi and delivery. The Telematics team uses digital signal processing and machine learning to turn that raw signal into a precise picture of how people actually drive. We use it to price insurance more fairly, to help drivers be safer on the road, and to power Zego Rewards, everyday rewards for good driving that turn car insurance into an engaging product rather than a box to tick.

We own the full telematics stack (mobile SDK, on-device ML, cloud pipeline) and the full pricing stack. So we can link driving behaviour directly to claim type, frequency and severity, and feed one system's predictions straight into the other. We are one of very few companies that owns that entire loop end to end, on in-house proprietary technology.

As Head of Telematics Data Science you will set the research agenda and own the technical direction of that work, reporting to the Director of Data. You will lead three data scientists directly and three ML engineers with a dotted line to you. The split is roughly 60% leading, 40% hands-on.

Our long-term ambition is driving behaviour modelling that holds up across countries and handsets, is highly predictive of claims risk, and is deeply integrated with driver coaching so we can offer the fairest price and the best experience to good drivers anywhere. Our partnership with Sompo Holdings, one of Japan's largest insurance groups, will take models trained on UK roads into an entirely different market.

 

The problems you will be working on

- Continuously pushing the predictive power of our existing algorithms and ML models

- Telling drivers apart from passengers using sensor data alone

- Detecting crashes and estimating their severity

- Bringing map and road-context data into our models in a way that genuinely improves prediction

- Handling handset and sensor heterogeneity, so a model behaves consistently on a five-year-old Android and a new iPhone

- On-device ML under real battery and compute constraints - trip detection already runs on the phone, and more could

- Making behavioural risk models transfer to new markets, starting with Japan

 

Several of these are open problems across the industry, not just at Zego.

 

What you will be doing

- Define and drive the technical roadmap, making sure the team is working on the highest-impact problems

- Lead the development of novel models to detect human behaviour and vehicle kinematics from high-frequency phone sensor data, on-device and in the cloud

- Act as the primary technical authority on telematics across the business, advising on existing products, surfacing patterns nobody has thought to l

Chainlink is the industry-standard oracle platform bringing the capital markets onchain and powering the majority of decentralized finance (DeFi). The Chainlink stack provides the essential data, interoperability, compliance, and privacy standards needed to power advanced blockchain use cases for institutional tokenized assets, lending, payments, stablecoins, and more. Since inventing decentralized oracle networks, Chainlink has enabled tens of trillions in transaction value and now secures the vast majority of DeFi.
Many of the world’s largest financial services institutions have also adopted Chainlink’s standards and infrastructure, including Swift, Euroclear, Mastercard, Fidelity International, UBS, S&P Dow Jones Indices, FTSE Russell, WisdomTree, ANZ, and top protocols such as Aave, Lido, GMX and many others. Chainlink leverages a novel fee model where offchain and onchain revenue from enterprise adoption is converted to LINK tokens and stored in a strategic Chainlink Reserve. Learn more at .
About The Role
As a Senior Solutions Engineer, you will play a crucial role in driving the adoption of Chainlink products across the capital markets industry as we continue to expand our presence there. You need to have deep, hands-on blockchain engineering expertise to join our customer-facing technical team. This role is the engine behind our PoC, pilot, and production deployment motion with equal parts pre/post-sales technical resource and delivery practitioner.
You will work directly with engineers, architects, and product owners at financial institutions, digital asset platforms, and capital markets infrastructure providers to design, build, and validate solutions. You are not a slide-deck engineer; you write code, deploy contracts, instrument integrations, and stand behind what you build when it goes live.
You will also work directly with internal teams such as Sales, Marketing, Product, Engineering and Legal and make a significant contribution to the ongoing development of the Chainlink capital markets product strategy.
Your Impact

• Drive the successful adoption of Chainlink products in the capital markets industry by establishing strong relationships with key stakeholders, including major financial institutions, and providing technical expertise and guidance throughout the sales and implementation process

• Contribute significantly to the development of the Chainlink capital markets product strategy by providing valuable insights, market feedback, and technical expertise, thereby influencing the direction and roadmap of the product suite

• Collaborate closely with internal technical teams, including developers and engineers, to provide feedback and guidance on product enhancements, bug fixes, and new feature development, ensuring that the capital markets requirements are effectively addressed

• Develop and maintain a comprehensive understanding of the capital markets industry, including market trends, challenges, and emerging technologies, to effectively position and promote Chainlink products

Requirements

• Experience with, and strong knowledge of blockchain technology and associated areas (e.g. DeFi, tokenisation / digital assets, digital identity etc)

• Hands-on experience with middleware, integration architecture patterns, web services technologies, and APIs

• Software engineering or solutions engineering experience, with at least 3 years in a customer-facing or delivery role (solutions engineering, professional services, technical consulting, or field engineering)

• Demonstrated experience building and deploying production or near-production blockchain applications, not just familiarity, but shipped code on public or private networks

• Proven track record delivering PoC or pilot engagements with enterprise customers, including scoping, build, demo, and documentation

title: General Opportunities - Psychiatrist
description:
Weekly outpatient therapy isn't always enough, and a trip to the ER isn't the only answer. Patients and their families rely on Compass Health Center when in crisis - every day, we help people overcome depression, anxiety, suicidality, obsessions/compulsions, trauma, chronic pain, and other obstacles in order for our patients to live freely.

About This Role

Hi, we’re so excited that you’re here and interested in a career at Compass! If you want some help finding the right path for you, you’re in the right place.
Between our 3 locations across the Chicagoland area, ever-growing virtual program, newest East Coast facility in Maryland, and our upcoming sites in Minnesota and Wisconsin, we have plenty of opportunities for a wide variety of clinical backgrounds and interests.
Maybe you’re looking for a role that’s not currently open, or just aren’t sure which program to apply to. Either way, we’d love to add you to our network of talented and passionate clinicians.
Simply leave your resume in our capable hands, and we’ll get in touch with you shortly to discuss the right opportunity for you. We can’t wait to meet you!
Who You Are:

• BE or BC in the state you are applying

• Licensed or ability to obtain Illinois Board of Medical Practice Licensure.

• Ability to obtain and/or maintain DEA certification for the State you are applying.

• Skilled in the evaluation and treatment of mental illness.

• Excellent communication skills and the desire to work in a collaborative, team-based environment.

We know job descriptions can be intimidating, so if this sounds like an opportunity for you, please don't hesitate to apply!

Who We Are

Compass Health Center is a recognized leader in crisis-level mental health, bringing passion, connection, and patient-centered care to the Partial Hospitalization and Intensive Outpatient space (PHP/IOP). Based in Chicagoland, we serve hundreds of patients every day, ranging from ages 5 through adulthood, in our onsite facilities or through our flourishing virtual programming. Compass fills a critical gap between outpatient and inpatient care through an intermediate level of Behavioral Healthcare.

A few more things we want you to know: our values are super important to us, and hopefully will be to you, too. Cultural humility, teamwork, continuous improvement, connection, patient centered care, passion, innovation, and agility should be your power sources. Joining Compass is an opportunity to feel fulfilled through a joint mission towards healing our communities.

Benefits & Perks

We know that you will be dedicated to your purpose here. We look at that investment as a two-way street. We are proud to offer plenty of space for growth, and opportunities to pursue continuous development within our organization.

For eligible positions, our other benefits include: comprehensive medical/dental/vision plans, 401k program with company matching, generous PTO (including competitive parental leave after 1 year of employment), and continuous training through CEU seminars and volunteering opportunities.

What’s Next?

Compass is committed to cultivating diverse and dynamic teams who exude passion for their craft, so whether or not you check all the boxes, we encourage you to apply - we’d be grateful to hear from you!

title: Controller
description:
About Bask & Lather Co.

Bask & Lather Co. is a fast-growing, scalp-first textured haircare company serving customers across direct-to-consumer, Amazon, TikTok Shop, and major retail channels. We are a lean, entrepreneurial organization that moves quickly, operates with high ownership, and expects team members to turn priorities into action without unnecessary layers or bureaucracy.

Role Overview

The Controller will own the accounting function end-to-end and serve as the backbone of financial integrity, reporting, and operational discipline. This role will partner closely with the Head of Finance to build scalable processes and support retail expansion.

This is a hands-on leadership role requiring both execution and system-building.

Key Responsibilities

1. Financial Close and Reporting

• Own the monthly, quarterly, and annual close processes.

• Establish a path to preliminary financial reporting within five business days and a complete, supportable close within ten business days.

• Prepare accurate, timely, and GAAP-compliant financial statements.

• Own balance-sheet reconciliations, accruals, reserves, account substantiation, and financial-statement support.

• Maintain complete, organized, and audit-ready documentation.

• Develop and maintain the accounting calendar, close checklist, and departmental deadlines.

• Coordinate external audit and tax requirements.

• Identify accounting issues proactively and present clear recommendations to the Head of Finance.

2. Inventory, COGS, and Gross-Margin Integrity

• Own inventory accounting across manufacturers, 3PLs, marketplaces, retail channels, and DTC operations.

• Reconcile inventory monthly among the general ledger, NetSuite, 3PL records, retailer activity, and internal inventory schedules.

• Establish reliable standard costs, landed costs, manufacturing variances, and SKU-level COGS.

• Own accounting for inventory in transit, shrinkage, obsolescence, damaged inventory, reserves, and write-offs.

• Partner with Supply Chain on purchase-order receipts, freight accruals, vendor reconciliations, and cycle-count controls.

• Investigate and resolve inventory discrepancies promptly.

• Improve gross-margin visibility by SKU, product category, channel, and customer.

• Ensure inventory accounting policies and valuation methodologies are consistently documented and applied.

3. Revenue and Channel Accounting

• Own revenue accounting and settlement reconciliation across Shopify, TikTok Shop, Amazon, Walmart, wholesale, and other marketplace and retail channels.

• Ensure appropriate revenue recognition, cutoff, and channel-level reporting.

• Reconcile platform settlements, transaction fees, refunds, returns, reserves, receivables, and cash receipts.

• Own accounting for retailer deductions, chargebacks, promotions, markdowns, allowances, and trade spend.

• Ensure accurate gross-to-net and contra-revenue treatment.

• Build controls to identify missing payments, invalid deductions, unreimbursed claims, and settlement discrepancies.

• Partner with Commercialization, E-Commerce, Customer Experience, and Supply Chain to resolve channel and retailer discrepancies.

• Maintain reliable supporting schedules for retail receivables, marketplace settlements, returns, and deductions.

4. Cash, Accounts Receivable, Accounts Payable, and Working Capital

• Oversee the accounts receivable and accounts payable functions, including management and development of the existing AP/AR Specialist.

• Maintain accurate daily and weekly cash reporting.

• Support short- and long-term cash-flow forecasting.

• Strengthen collections discipline and retailer receivables management.

• Improve vendor-payment controls, approval workflows, and payment timing.

• Partner with the Head of Finance and Supply Chain to improve the cash conversion cycle.

• Monitor aged receivables, vendor liabilities, accruals, and working-capital risks.

• Maintain appropriate segregation of duties and payment auth

title: AI Security Engineer
description:
AI Security Engineer - Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.
This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: AI Security Engineer
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $100,000-$150,000 Annually
Experience Required: 8+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary:
We are seeking an AI Security Engineer to lead the design and implementation of security controls, threat models, and incident response capabilities specifically tailored to AI and machine learning systems. The role addresses the unique security challenges posed by LLMs, model APIs, training data pipelines, and AI-powered applications, including prompt injection, model abuse, data exfiltration, and supply chain risks. The ideal candidate has strong security engineering fundamentals and a deep understanding of how modern AI systems work in practice, with hands-on experience designing defenses for both AI-powered applications and the AI infrastructure that supports them.

Key Responsibilities

• Define and implement security controls specifically targeting LLM and AI-powered application risks.

• Build threat models for AI systems, including prompt injection, jailbreaks, data exfiltration, and abuse patterns.

• Design and deploy guardrails, content filters, and policy enforcement layers around model endpoints.

• Implement runtime detection and response capabilities for adversarial prompts and abusive behavior.

• Secure training and fine-tuning pipelines, including data provenance, integrity, and access controls.

• Design controls for sensitive data handling, retention, and redaction in LLM workflows.

• Lead red-team exercises against AI systems and drive remediation of identified weaknesses.

• Evaluate and harden third-party AI services and open-source AI components used internally.

• Implement identity, authorization, and tenant-isolation patterns for multi-tenant AI services.

• Drive supply chain security for ML artifacts including weights, datasets, and inference dependencies.

• Collaborate with privacy, legal, and compliance teams to ensure AI systems meet regulatory obligations.

• Develop monitoring, logging, and detection strategies tailored to AI workloads.

• Lead incident response for AI-specific security events and drive durable improvements.

• Stay current with adversarial ML, LLM security research, and emerging regulatory developments.

title: Account Development Representative - France
description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing - and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the Role

As an Account Development Representative (ADR) at Samsara, you will be trained, both on the job and with formal training programs led by a world-class team of sales professionals, to take on your next role as closing Account Executive. 

On a daily basis, you will be responsible for sourcing pipelines for our EMEA business, generating opportunities via outbound outreach. 

We have offices in Paris and London and we offer remote working from Germany, France and the United Kingdom.

This is a remote position open to candidates based in France, Germany, and the United Kingdom. This position requires working hours in CEST. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

You should apply if: 

• You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact-helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.

• You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. Successful ADRs can see promotion to a closing role in two years or less.

• You love talking to people: In this role, you will average 60+ calls to prospective customers daily.

• You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support to make a larger impact.

• You treat rejection as a learning experience: In this role, you will get hung up on and you will get told no. You need to have the resilience to pick up the phone again and again to sell Samsara’s mission.

• You want to be with the best: Samsara’s high-performance Sales culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.

In this role, you will:  

• Drive pipeline through personalized outreach to prospects via phone, emails and LinkedIn

• Have the opportunity to to participate in trade/shows events to represent the Samsara brand and connect with prospective customers and partners.

• Become a product expert and learn the Samsara way of selling

• Keep meticulous records of interactions with accounts in our CRM (Salesforce.com)

• Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

• 1-3 years professional experience, ideally in customer facing roles

• 6-12 months sales experience as a minimum

• Highly motivated and committed, with strong desire to work in target driven sales

• Proven track record of consistent over achievement of targets/expectations of previous roles

• Excellent communication skills, verbal and written

title: Sr. Manager, Corporate Development & Ventures

description:
MongoDB is hiring a Senior Manager, Corporate Development & Ventures to help drive our inorganic growth strategy - partnering closely with our Sr. Director of Corporate Development & Ventures on M&A and strategic investment activity.

This role is for someone who wants to own M&A execution end-to-end. You'll independently source, evaluate, and run a steady pipeline of deals, partnering with the Sr. Director and VP on our highest-stakes transactions. Once a deal signs an LOI, you become the day-to-day driver - the person Finance, Legal, HR, and the business count on to get it through close and integration.

You'll work closely with Product, Engineering, Finance, People, and other business stakeholders to help shape decisions about MongoDB's position in data infrastructure and AI. The role sits primarily in Corporate Development, with regular exposure to our Ventures platform.

What you’ll bring

• Has 4-8 years of experience in Corporate Development, Investment Banking, Private Equity, or Venture Capital

• Has meaningful experience running deal workstreams and is ready to own transactions end-to-end with real autonomy

• Is comfortable operating independently, while knowing when to bring in the Sr. Director, VP, or other senior leaders

• Demonstrates strong judgment, particularly under time pressure and incomplete information

• Holds a high bar for analytical rigor, but knows when to move without perfect data

• Can engage credibly with technical leaders while maintaining a clear business perspective

• Is direct, low-ego, and accountable - focused on outcomes, not process

What you will do

Own Deals, End-to-End

• Independently source, evaluate, and run your own pipeline of M&A and investment opportunities, from initial engagement through LOI

• Build and pressure-test valuation, structure, and strategic rationale, partnering with the Sr. Director and VP on the most complex or highest-stakes calls

• Know when to move on your own judgment and when to escalate

Be the Function's Go-To Person from LOI Through Close

• Once a deal signs an LOI, step in as the primary driver across every Corp Dev workstream to close - including the Sr. Director and VP's most strategic transactions

• Run tight, focused diligence across technical, product, commercial, and financial dimensions

• Coordinate structuring and cross-functional input so nothing stalls between LOI and closure

• Bring structure and clarity to the ambiguity that shows up in the final stretch of a deal

• Serve as the primary driver through LOI signing, partner with the Integration Team and cross-functional stakeholders on integration planning, then hand off cleanly to the Integration team

Convert Market Insight into Action

• Partner with the Ventures team to surface actionable opportunities from a strong, continuously refreshed pipeline

• Maintain a precise understanding of the competitive and technological landscape

• Move quickly and flag high-conviction opportunities to the Sr. Director and VP

Operate Effectively with Senior Stakeholders

• Partner directly with Product and Engineering leaders on strategic fit and integration

• Work with Finance and Legal to structure and close transactions efficiently

• Communicate clearly and concisely with stakeholders across the business, including senior leadership

What Success Looks Like

• You independently own and close well-scoped transactions end-to-end

• Once a deal hits LOI, you’re the person the Sr. Director and cross-functional partners rely on to drive it to close

• MongoDB runs multiple live deals simultaneously without losing focus or rigor

• You’ve built the track record and judgment to take on progressively larger and more strategic transactions

• The overall quality and effectiveness of the Corporate Development function increases materially

Position Expectations

• Based in San Francisco, New York, or Austin

• Reports to the Sr. Director of Corporate Development & Ventures

title: Forklift Driver (Nights)
description:
Ready to revolutionize healthcare, making it faster and more accessible than ever before? 

How we started:

Founded in 2013 by Dwayne D’Souza, HeliosX   was built on a simple but powerful idea: healthcare should be easier to access, faster to receive, and centred around the individual. From day one, we’ve grown without external funding; scaling profitably through technology, disciplined execution, and deep medical expertise. What started as a challenger idea has become one of the most significant healthcare platforms operating globally today.

Where we are now:

We’ve earned the trust of millions of people worldwide through category-leading products and well-known brands, including MedExpress, Dermatica, ZipHealth, RocketRX, and Levity. A key driver of our success is vertical integration; we operate our own manufacturing and proprietary products, led by in-house medical teams, researchers, and pharmacists at the top of their fields.

In 2025, HeliosX treated more than 1.7 million patients globally and reached £781m in revenue, representing +337% year-on-year growth and cementing our position as the clear market leader in the UK. That growth translates into real-world outcomes: our weight-loss treatments helped patients lose 8.5 million kilograms of excess weight in 2025 alone, contributing to an estimated 1,300 fewer cardiac events. This is growth with measurable, life-changing impact at scale.

Today, we operate across four international markets, with successful launches in Germany and Canada and continued expansion in the US. We were also recently recognised in the Sunday Times Top 100 fastest-growing tech companies, further validation of both our momentum and our ambition.

Where we’re going:

2026 is another significant year for HeliosX. Our ambition is to surpass £1.1bn in revenue, continue expanding thoughtfully into new international markets and broaden our condition and treatment portfolio. As we scale, we're focused on building the technology, operational excellence and clinical capabilities that will support sustainable long-term growth. Joining HeliosX now means helping shape the systems, teams and products that will define the next chapter of digital healthcare. You'll be solving complex problems at pace, working alongside exceptional people and building products that genuinely improve lives at scale.

There’s never been a more exciting time to join HeliosX. Come be a part of making our dream of easier and faster healthcare a reality!

• Support stock control processes, including inventory checks and accurate record-keeping.

• Ensure the safe and compliant disposal of waste packaging materials.

• Maintain high standards of cleanliness, organisation

title: Contract Writer for a Gospels and Acts Commentary
description:
Location: Remote
Overview
We are seeking a theologically trained writer to join a collaborative team developing a Christ-centered commentary on the Gospels and Acts. This project is written for the thoughtful, everyday Bible student who wants to go deeper-without requiring highly technical academic detail. The commentary should reflect careful exegesis and a clearly articulated Christ-centered hermeneutic. Our goal is to land between conversational pastoral commentaries and academic volumes-accessible, theologically rich, and intellectually serious. An ecumenical tone is imperative throughout, engaging interpretive differences with charity and avoiding unnecessary polemics.
Scope of Work

• Collaborate with a team of contributors under editorial and theological oversight

• Research and write assigned portions of the Gospels and/or Acts

• Provide clear, structured commentary that includes:

• Literary and historical context

• Explanation of key theological themes

• Engagement with major interpretive questions

• Selective interaction with the original languages where illuminating (without becoming technical)

• Articulate how each passage contributes to the revelation of Christ and the mission of the early church

• Write for serious lay readers-clear and accessible, but not simplified

• Address areas of theological disagreement with fairness, clarity, and ecumenical charity

• Revise material in response to editorial and peer review

• Ensure alignment with the organization’s doctrinal commitments

• Explicit Christ-centered and redemptive-historical connections

• Draw out thoughtful, textually grounded practical application for contemporary readers

• Write not merely to inform, but to form aiming at spiritual transformation, worship, and deeper trust in Christ

Qualifications

• Master of Divinity (M.Div.) or another advanced theology degree required

• Demonstrated competency in New Testament exegesis

• Working knowledge of Koine Greek

• A clearly articulated Christ-centered hermeneutic

• Familiarity with major evangelical scholarship on the Gospels and Acts

• Demonstrated capacity to engage diverse theological perspectives with humility and care

• Experience in pastoral ministry, theological education, or substantive Bible teaching preferred

• Ability to write clearly for educated lay readers

• Comfortable collaborating within a multi-author theological project

• Willingness to receive and implement substantive editorial feedback

Commitment
Contract, per-project basis.
Compensation
Compensation is determined based on project scope and complexity.
Additional Information
Contractors are engaged based on the needs of specific projects and are not guaranteed ongoing or full-time work. Participation in meetings, workshops, or collaborative sessions may be requested depending on the project timeline.

With over a decade of publishing experience, The Daily Grace Co. creates Christ-centered resources marked by theological depth, biblical faithfulness, and practical encouragement. We value thoughtful, faithful writers and partner closely from concept development through launch. Our goal is not simply to publish Bible studies-but to serve readers with resources that meet real needs and help them treasure Christ.

• Institutions attended

• Greek coursework and competency

• Ministry, teaching, or academic experience

• Previous publications (if applicable)

2. Exegetical Writing Sample (5-10 pages)

• A previously published exegetical work (preferred), or

This enables hundreds of thousands of people to achieve financial stability for themselves and their families while providing essential care to millions of people across the U.S.

Founded in 2016, we are a remote-first team of over 1,000 people building a top Y-Combinator company https://www.ycombinator.com/topcompanies/ and have been profitable since 2022. We’re the leader in Long-Term Care staffing and are rapidly expanding into Home Health, Hospitals, and more, meaning we have more work to do than people to do it, and are growing our team to support millions more people and their communities.

 

OVERVIEW

We are hiring an Applied AI Strategy & Ops Lead to own and evolve our internal tooling ecosystem across Ops. This is a hands-on individual contributor role with real ownership. You’ll work across a range of tools including support platforms, AI-driven systems, and internal automations to improve how our day-to-day operations function.

You'll sit at the intersection of Operations and Engineering, acting as the technical voice of Ops and partner closely with team leadership to execute against defined priorities, refine existing systems, and introduce new tooling where needed ensuring our stack continues to scale effectively with the business.

 

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Build and iterate on workflows, integrations, and automations that improve day-to-day efficiency

- Execute against high-priority tooling and automation initiatives across the operational stack.

- Partner with engineers and developers to scope requirements, write technical specs, and prioritize tooling work that matters most to Ops.

- Improve systems across multiple tools, including support platforms and AI-driven solutions

- Translate defined problems into practical, well-scoped technical solutions

- Identify gaps or inefficiencies in current tooling and proactively address them

- Troubleshoot issues, improve system reliability, and ensure tools perform effectively in production

- Contribute to ongoing improvements in how our systems connect and operate together

 

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

- Technical Fluency - You’re comfortable working with APIs, integrations, and automation tooling. You can build and debug independently and hold your own in technical conversations with engineers.

- Execution Discipline - You take defined problems and drive them through to completion. You manage multiple priorities effectively and maintain a high bar for quality and reliability.

- Systems Thinking - You understand how tools, workflows, and dependencies connect. You look for ways to improve how systems operate together, not just individual components.

- Problem Solving - You can take loosely defined or scoped problems and translate them into practical, well-structured solutions.

- Ownership Mindset - You take responsibility for delivering high-quality work and improving the team’s day-to-day operations through better tooling and processes.

 

NICE TO HAVE

- Experience working with support platforms such as Zendesk

- Familiarity with AI-driven tools and automation workflows

HIRING PROCESS

Quavo is the industry leader in fraud and disputes management technology, offering the world’s only E2E cloud-based Disputes as a Service solution for issuing financial services organizations. Quavo is an organization of tenacious experts who are innovative and challenge complacency to continuously deliver cutting edge technology and AI. Our experts are passionate about delivering value in our solutions and empowering our client community to enhance and evolve industry standards in fraud and disputes management.

About the role:

As Director, Talent Development, come build with us. Join a passionate, highly capable team and help us grow our people, as leaders, as individuals, and as a team of experts who make it right. Help us build upon the foundation of the Quavo Mastery Program, our approach to leadership and talent development built specifically for Quavo. You'll validate the approach and accelerate the build. You'll also decide where custom-built programming is the right call and where buying existing content is the faster, more deliberate path. That judgment is yours to make.

Quavo has grown revenue 12x in five years, and our processes, systems, and org structure continue to evolve. Being deliberate matters here: you're designing development built to flex and evolve alongside the business.

You'll also take an innovative approach to building AI fluency in our leaders and teams, while designing against the cognitive offloading that heavy, unmanaged AI use can create.

Reporting to the CPO, this role also oversees our part-time Employment Enablement Architect.

Responsibilities include:

• Own and accelerate the Quavo Mastery Program, calling the shots on where to build custom content versus buy

• Speed up time to productivity for new hires and time to readiness for leaders through better-designed development programs

• Build programming as modular, flexible content that keeps pace as our processes, systems, and org structure evolve

• Build AI fluency in leaders and teams while designing against the cognitive offloading that comes with heavy, unmanaged use

• Manage and develop our part-time Employment Enablement Architect for maximum impact against limited hours

• Partner with GTM teams to keep how we represent our product and ourselves consistent, internally and externally

• Own outcomes end to end, from decision to result, staying authentic, clear, and direct with leaders and teams along the way

Required Qualifications:

• 7+ years in talent or leadership development, including experience in a fast-growth or PE-backed environment, with sound judgment on when to build custom content versus buy and deploy an existing program

• Comfortable building programs while the org underneath them is still moving, designing for iteration as the business evolves

• Strong point of view on adult learning design and cohort-based leadership development

• An outstanding facilitator and trainer yourself, innovative in how you design, act, and improve with pace and intent

• Experience integrating AI into learning design in a way that builds real capability, with a clear approach to preventing the critical-thinking erosion that comes with over-reliance on it

• Experience managing a part-time or matrixed team member and getting full value from limited capacity

• Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Organizational Development, Learning & Development, or a related field, or equivalent experience; master's degree a plus

Preferred Qualifications:

• Direct experience transitioning a previously outsourced leadership development function to an in-house team

• Experience in a fintech, payments, or B2B SaaS environment

title: Director of Business Systems Product Management
description:
Who We Are

Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy-sensitive AI-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management. 

We’ve got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100+ of the Fortune 500), a $5.8B valuation , more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. Physical AI is one of the most consequential technology shifts of our time, and Verkada is at the center of it.

You can look at all kinds of communities to see our platform’s impact in the world. It's the retailer that uses our agentic AI to deter theft before it happens. The warehouse that uses AI-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE. The school that’s alerted to a threat in real-time and triggers a lockdown in seconds, not minutes. We’re rapidly scaling this impact: today, more than 2 million Verkada devices are deployed across 170+ countries. 

About the Role

This role leads the Business Systems Product team in the CIO organization.

Verkada runs on four value streams - Quote-to-Cash, Attract-to-Hire-to-Retire, Procure-to-Pay, and Record-to-Report. The systems behind them decide how fast the company can sell, hire, source, ship, and close the books. You own the product functions across them.

The portfolio spans both sides of the company. Some of these systems face partners and customers, where the experience is part of how Verkada competes and where the ambition is to be the easiest company in the industry to do business with. Others face employees, where the experience drives how the company scales. The bar is the same on both sides: systems people choose to use, intuitive enough to need almost no training, and scalable so overall company growth exceeds the rate of headcount growth. 

Your team is organized by the functions it serves: Partner Ecosystem (Partner Portal and vStore), Finance, Supply Chain & Operations, Legal, and People. Each product manager owns the systems roadmap for their function and acts as the product counterpart to that function's leadership. You own the whole - including the parts that only work when someone connects them. A partner order has to land cleanly in NetSuite. A headcount plan has to reconcile between Workday and the financial model.

This is a fully onsite role in our San Mateo HQ

What You'll Do

• Build streamlined features for pricing configurations, automated approvals, checkout, payments, and fund requests (MDF/JSF) to enable partners to operate without manual intervention.

• Recruit and coach 6-10 PMs to write strong requirements, manage roadmaps, and serve as strategic partners to business leaders.

• Drive product strategy, architecture, and roadmap for all enterprise business systems to support scalable, public-company growth. Lead a team of 6-10 PMs and analysts across key operational domains.

• Define the systems roadmap, lead make-vs-buy decisions, manage total cost of ownership (TCO), and establish a standardized intake process for all business requests.

• Partner Ecosystem & vStore: Build and scale self-service portal for quoting, deal registration, order management, and billing.

• Finance: Oversee NetSuite order-to-cash and financial close systems.

• Supply Chain: Manage inventory, order processing, logistics, and contract manufacturer integrations.

• Legal & People: Automate employee lifecycle systems and identity/access provisioning.

• Build SOX-ready controls, auditability, and data warehouse integrations to public-company standards.

What You Bring

• Bachelor's degree in MIS, CS, Finance, Business, or another technical/analytical field.

• 10+ years in product management, business systems, or a related technical role, including 3+ years leading product managers. E

title: Senior Software Engineer (Cloud Network)
description:
ABOUT NU

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page https://www.nu.com/2026-en

ABOUT THE ROLE

Every transaction at Nubank travels across a network before it reaches a customer. As we grow across countries, accounts, regions and hybrid environments, the connectivity layer underneath has to stay fast, segmented, auditable and cheap to run - while never becoming the thing that takes the platform down.

As a Senior Software Engineer on a Cloud Network platform engineering team, you set and evolve the technical direction for how Nubank connects its cloud, hybrid and on-premises environments. You own problems whose scope spreads across several teams and business units, and you are expected to bring structure to ambiguity rather than wait for it to be resolved for you.

YOU'LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

- Setting and evolving the technical direction of the cloud network platform owned by your team, aligning with Nubank's canonical approaches and contributing back to the broader technical community.

- Support complex network projects and processes end to end - working independently, coordinating across subjects and stakeholders, and escalating for managerial support in a timely way rather than reactively.

- Proactively reducing long-term complexity through simplification, consolidation, deprecation and paved roads, explicitly balancing scalability, maintainability and cost, and considering both human and AI interaction with the platform.

- Owning the operational health of the network platform in your team's scope: leading complex incident response (diagnosis, coordination, resolution), driving complex postmortems, and owning the short- and long-term tech debt strategy that comes out of them.

- Promoting a culture of safe change - feature flags, gradual rollout, monitoring, fast rollback - applied to network changes, and driving simplification and cost optimization across the topology.

- Setting and enforcing quality standards for the team's automation and infrastructure code: testing practices, code review bar, reusable modules, and anticipation of quality and maintainability needs coming from business strategy.

- Defining observability for the platform - robust monitoring, controls and SLAs that surface issues proactively rather than after customer impact.

- Bringing a strong end-to-end domain understanding: tracing a business process from product through the transactional path down to the network and data layers, and understanding how network design choices propagate through it.

- Owning the network security posture of your scope, including PCI DSS or equivalent standards, segmentation, and controls that hold up under audit.

- Evaluating buy vs. build options and new products and technologies, being data-driven about stability, reliability, scalability and cost before committing to a solution.

- Participating in hiring as a core part of the role, contributing to function-wide taskforces and initiatives, and documenting decisions so that knowledge travels across teams, not just within yours.

- CCIE, CCNP or equivalent experience - you are comfortable designing, building, implementing, maintaining and troubleshooting complex, large-scale networking infrastructures.

title: Independent Contractor Salesforce Integration Specialist (Remote Americas)

FTG is the global authority on hospitality excellence. • Strong understanding of Salesforce CRM data structures, objects, and Flow Builder

• Proven ability to troubleshoot integration issues and perform structured testing across connected systems

• Excellent problem-solving and communication skills; ability to work independently and efficiently in a remote team environment

Nice-to-Have Skills

• Salesforce Certified Platform Administrator II and/or Salesforce Certified Platform App Builder certifications

• Familiarity with Salesforce Marketing Cloud or marketing automation workflows

• Experience documenting system architecture or integration workflows

WHY HARVEY

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth - personal, professional, and financial - is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission - operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today - and we’re just getting started.

ROLE OVERVIEW

The Software Engineer, New Grad joins Harvey's Engineering team, working alongside experienced engineers to build the AI-powered systems that serve the world's leading law firms and enterprises. The team's mission is to deliver secure, intuitive, and high-performance application-layer experiences that turn frontier AI capabilities into real customer value. This role offers an accelerated path to ownership, contributing production code to features spanning retrieval, document intelligence, and workflow automation from day one. It is an opportunity to develop rapidly at the intersection of AI and professional services, with direct exposure to how engineers shape a category-defining product.

We're currently hiring new grads to start in 2027 across multiple teams and roles, including Frontend, Backend, Full-Stack, Infrastructure, and Applied AI roles. - Collaborate with cross-functional teams including AI Research, Legal Engineering, Product, and Design to translate problem statements into compelling product experiences.

- Collaborate with your team through code reviews, technical design discussions, and engineering best-practice development alongside senior and staff engineers.

- Experiment with and evaluate cutting-edge LLMs and AI systems, contributing to how Harvey's platform evolves.

- Depending on your team, you could work on retrieval over large document collections, interfaces for collaborating with AI systems, multi-region compute infrastructure, enterprise agents, or secure systems for sensitive client data.

- Previous internship experience is required.

- Technical foundation. Strong proficiency in one or more languages (Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, Java, Go, or similar) and solid general computer science knowledge.

description:

Enlighten provides continued innovation and proactivity in meeting our customers’ greatest challenges.

We recognize that the most effective environment for your projects doesn’t always look the same. Our hybrid work approach ensures that you can make lasting relationships with your team and collaborate in-person to get the job done-while having the flexibility to work from home when needed to achieve focused results.
Why Enlighten?
At Enlighten, our team’s unwavering work ethic, top talent and celebration of innovative ideas have helped us thrive. We know that our employees are essential to our company’s success, so we seek to take care of you as much as you take care of us. Here are a few highlights of our benefits package:
• 100% paid employee premium for healthcare, vision and dental plans.
• 10% 401k benefit.
• Generous PTO + 10 paid holidays.
• Education/training allowances.
Anticipated Salary Range: $119,574.00 - $235,000.00. The salary range for this role is intended as a good faith estimate based on the role's location, expectations, and responsibilities. When extending an offer, Enlighten takes a variety of factors into consideration which include, but are not limited to, the role's function, internal equity and a candidate's education or training, work experience, certifications and key skills. Occasionally positions/roles may include additional non-recurrent compensation and will be addressed by the recruiter during the interview process.

Job Description

Enlighten is looking for a Senior Platform Delivery & Reliability Engineer to own the rollout of our data lakehouse platform across a large, multi-site government enterprise, currently ~50 production Kubernetes clusters and growing. This role is a rare hybrid of platform engineer, SRE, and delivery lead. You can deploy the platform, debug anything you encounter in the field, feed what you learn back to the engineering teams, and help fix underlying issues in the code base. Just as importantly, you can step back from any individual issue and fix the system that produced it by building the processes, tooling, and communication channels inside Enlighten that make every deployment faster and less painful than the one before it.

You will be a full member of the Infrastructure team, working daily with our Ingest, Query, Application and Testing teams as well as government customers and site personnel. Success in this role looks like: rollouts across the enterprise happen predictably and efficiently, issues found in the field are cataloged, communicated, and resolved quickly, and the friction that slows deployments steadily disappears.

#Senior Level

Essential Job Responsibilities

• Plan, coordinate, and execute deployments and upgrades of the data lakehouse platform across 50 production Kubernetes clusters in customer environments.

• Debug and troubleshoot critical issues anywhere in the stack (infrastructure, Kubernetes, platform services, data services, and applications) and drive them to root cause.

• Contribute patches, configuration changes, and automation improvements directly back to the platform.

• Catalog and triage issues discovered in the field, communicate them clearly to the Infrastructure, Ingest, Query, and Application teams, and maintain a living knowledge base of failure modes, fixes, and runbooks.

• Enable and improve site reliability for fielded environments: monitoring, alerting, incident response, and continuous reliability improvement.

title: Chief Analytics Officer (CAO) — Insurance & Investments
signals: based in saint vincent and the grenadines
description:
Job Summary
The Chief Analytics Officer (CAO) is the executive leader responsible for using enterprise data, advanced analytics, AI, and business intelligence to improve strategic and operational decision-making.
Within Insurance & Investments, the CAO typically oversees analytics across underwriting, claims, pricing, customer intelligence, fraud, risk, actuarial insights, investment performance, portfolio analytics, financial planning, regulatory reporting, and enterprise performance.
Key Responsibilities
Define and execute the organization's enterprise analytics strategy.
Establish an enterprise-wide analytics operating model, roadmap, standards, and priorities.
Lead advanced analytics, predictive analytics, AI/ML, data science, and business intelligence.
Translate complex data into actionable insights for CEO, Board, executives, and business leaders.
Develop analytics capabilities for:
Underwriting and risk selection
Claims and loss analysis
Pricing and profitability
Customer segmentation and retention
Fraud detection
Risk and capital analytics
Portfolio and investment performance
Asset allocation
Market and investment research
Financial forecasting
Regulatory and management reporting
Establish enterprise analytics KPIs and measurement frameworks.
Drive predictive modelling and scenario analysis to support strategic decisions.
Partner with the CIO/CDO/CTO on data architecture, data platforms, governance, integration, and technology modernization.
Ensure analytical models use reliable, governed, secure, and appropriately controlled data.
Develop self-service BI and executive dashboards.
Identify opportunities for AI and automation across business functions.
Establish model governance, validation, monitoring, and responsible AI practices.
Support actuarial, risk, finance, investment, compliance, and executive decision-making.
Lead enterprise analytics transformation and data-driven culture.
Build, manage, and develop high-performing teams across analytics, data science, BI, and AI.
Manage analytics budgets, vendors, strategic technology partners, and external data providers.
Communicate analytical findings and business implications to senior executives and the Board.
Ensure analytics activities align with regulatory, privacy, risk, and financial-services requirements.
Ideal Candidate Profile
15+ years of experience across analytics, data science, BI, statistics, quantitative analysis, or related fields.
7+ years in senior analytics/data leadership.
Previous experience as:
Chief Analytics Officer
Chief Data & Analytics Officer
Chief Data Officer
Head of Data & Analytics
Head of Analytics
Group Head of Analytics
Director of Data & Analytics
Analytics Director
VP Data & Analytics
Strong experience in Insurance, Banking, Investment Management, Asset Management, Wealth Management, or Financial Services.
Strong understanding of:
Advanced analytics
Predictive modelling
AI/ML
Data science
Business intelligence
Data strategy
Data governance
Data architecture
Statistical modelling
Data visualization
Scenario/stress testing
Experience converting analytics into measurable business outcomes.
Strong executive stakeholder management and Board-level communication.
Experience leading large, multidisciplinary analytics/data teams.
Strong commercial and strategic understanding of financial-services businesses.
Bachelor's degree required; Master's/PhD in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, Finance, Actuarial Science, or a related field is advantageous.
